recipes.description: State an exact operation ID, HTTP method, or path.
generation_rules: Copy one exact operation ID, full path, or literal uppercase HTTP method into the final query
Request only the source endpoint
Do not substitute a natural-language verb for the required exact API surface

recipes.description: Express one endpoint naturally with familiar capability language.
generation_rules: Use ordinary user language
Preserve action, resource, and constraints
Do not mention an operation ID or HTTP path
Do not copy the endpoint summary or description verbatim

recipes.description: Express the endpoint intent without its identifying API surface words.
generation_rules: Avoid every supplied forbidden surface term in the final query
Use synonyms while preserving intent
Do not add constraints
Check the final query token by token against the forbidden list before returning it

recipes.description: Preserve the endpoint goal with deliberately low overlap against endpoint metadata.
generation_rules: Minimize overlap with supplied endpoint surface terms
Keep the request interpretable
Preserve action and resource semantics

recipes.description: Add bounded informal spelling or spacing noise without changing intent.
generation_rules: Add one to three realistic noise edits
Keep the intended action and resource recoverable
Do not introduce another endpoint intent

recipes.description: Surround one endpoint request with plausible irrelevant context.
generation_rules: Include one clear actionable intent
Add plausible non-actionable distractor context
Do not request extra fields, constraints, or another endpoint outcome in the distractor

recipes.description: State the desired endpoint and explicitly exclude a sibling action.
generation_rules: State the source endpoint action positively and completely
Explicitly reject only the supplied sibling action
Do not ask for the excluded action before saying instead
Use a literal negation marker

recipes.description: Make the current request depend on supplied prior endpoint context.
generation_rules: Use a short follow-up that requires the supplied context
Do not restate the full endpoint intent
Keep one resolvable endpoint truth

recipes.description: Use a pronoun or reference whose target appears only in conversation context.
generation_rules: Refer to the contextual object indirectly
Require the supplied reference to recover endpoint truth
Do not introduce a second referent

recipes.description: Explicitly supersede a previous request with the intended endpoint.
generation_rules: State or imply a previous different request
Clearly replace it with the source endpoint intent
Make only the corrected request actionable

recipes.description: Present two incompatible real endpoint intents that require clarification.
generation_rules: Include both supplied endpoint outcomes
Present them as unresolved alternatives using either/or or an explicit not-sure marker
Do not ask to perform both outcomes
Do not resolve which outcome is preferred

recipes.description: Make endpoint intent clear while leaving one or more OpenAPI-required inputs absent.
generation_rules: Clearly request the source endpoint
Do not invent values for missing required inputs
Keep provided inputs explicit
Write the user's operation request, never an assistant-like request for the missing values

recipes.description: Request two independent endpoint outcomes with no data dependency.
generation_rules: Request both supplied endpoint outcomes
Do not make either depend on output from the other
Allow either execution order

recipes.description: Request an ordered endpoint sequence where a later input comes from an earlier response.
generation_rules: Request every supplied step
Explicitly say that a value returned by the first step is used as input to the next step
Preserve required order

recipes.description: Request a capability absent from the named target but belonging to a named external API.
generation_rules: Name the external API or domain
Request the source-backed external capability
Do not request a target capability

recipes.description: Request a source-backed capability absent from every catalog in the complete registry.
generation_rules: Request the supplied external action and resource concretely
Do not mention a capability from the registered catalogs
Preserve the external source meaning
Do not turn the request into a generic question about what the external service can do

recipes.description: Provide too little evidence to construct any meaningful endpoint choice.
generation_rules: Do not state a usable action and resource pair
Do not imply a known endpoint
Do not use either/or or create two concrete alternatives
Keep the vague request natural and short
